rows.text: The Kantei page 内閣総理大臣指示（第３次補正予算編成について）, dated 平成23年9月2日 with the sub-heading 初閣議, records the Prime Minister's instruction at the first cabinet meeting on the third supplementary budget for recovery from the Great East Japan Earthquake.
